descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S06 Discharge time edges: no time, 20, 25, 30, 31, 45 minutes, 1 hour, 'over 30', and a non-discharge duration; SNF discharge no time, 30, 'more than 30'

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Discharge (Hospital 99238 / 99239, SNF 99315 / 99316): if the time is in the note, the code is set from it (<= 30 min -> 99238 / 99315, > 30 min -> 99239 / 99316); … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 5; TFA-92596 What (SNF discharge new family)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 1; TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Discharge-summary notes that differ only in the time sentence

When Run the billing step once per cell

Then No time -> no code, the result asks for <= 30 / > 30 min; <= 30 -> 99238 / 99315; > 30 -> 99239 / 99316

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per cell: asksForTime + noCode for the no-time cells and for the distractor (a non-discharge duration is not discharge time, Q3); codeIn the single expected code otherwise, and every timed cell also asksForTime false and noLevelWords (no 'Straightforward', 'Low', 'Moderate' or 'High' outside quotes: time-based codes carry no MDM level, Q2). …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
